text:
Maria Gonzalez: Heads up — opened a docs PR for rate limits / quotas / pricing section. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482. Main changes: tier table, metering examples, and a short guide on how usage shows up in the Console. Need quick review + someone to fix the broken dashboard screenshot path.

Kevin Li: on it. quick question — do we want to standardize on the header names in examples? I used `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset` in the examples.

Maria Gonzalez: yes please keep those. also added a small snippet showing how we surface quotas per-token vs per-request in the billing UI.

Alex Park: for Dedicated customers we should call out that quotas are enforced per-reservation instead of per-account. added a short migration note in the PR but it might need an ops review.

Samir Patel: spotted one broken link in the PR — the Billing API anchor changed. current link in the doc points to `/billing#metering` but it should be `/billing/metering`. I can push a follow-up commit unless someone else already fixed it.

Diane Chu: I can update the dashboard screenshots. where are the Figma/export files? Maria — did you replace the old images with the new cropped ones?

Maria Gonzalez: Diane — I included the screenshots in `/assets/console/usage-v2.png` but that path is wrong (typo). should be `/assets/console/usage-dashboard-v2.png`. Diane feel free to rename and export better resolution.

Kevin Li: small nit on wording: "requests" vs "tokens" — in metering examples we show both. suggest we add a one-line clarifier: `Metering units: requests (API calls) and tokens (generated/consumed) — pricing is per-token by default.`

Alex Park: also added a code example for client SDK where you can read headers:
```js
const res = await client.generate(...);
console.log(res.headers['x-ratelimit-remaining']);
```
Keep it short.

Samir Patel: pushed fix for billing link in a separate commit (sha: f2d9c4a). also added a tiny note about burst allowance for free tier (30 req/min burst).

Diane Chu: grabbed the PNGs and re-exported at 2x. uploaded to `/assets/console/usage-dashboard-v2.png`. replaced low-res images in the PR.

Maria Gonzalez: awesome, thank you all. one last ask — can someone from product sign off on the pricing tier wording? I changed the discount rounding note and want to avoid legal surprises. @Kevin Li or @Alex Park?

Kevin Li: I'll do a final pass after lunch and sign off if wording ok. ping me if you want the exact phrasing changed. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: PR #482 status: checks passed — CI, lint; reviewers requested: Kevin Li, Alex Park.

Maria Gonzalez: marking this thread resolved for now. will merge after Kevin sign-off and I squash the typo commits. thanks everyone! :pray:
